work_package: WP-7E: give the four unpinned producers a digest of their own
head: a83ac16532f2a8b5ea131b25910d4b57abf9fe0e
authority: the commit that carries this file; re-pinning is an explicit, reviewed act that must accompany regeneration and re-verification of the artefacts
admissible_byte_conventions: a consumer must accept a watched producer whose bytes equal the pinned content in LF or CRLF form (sha256_lf / sha256_crlf); sha256 records the bytes of the tree that wrote this manifest and is informational only. A checkout with core.autocrlf rewrites line endings without touching content, so requiring the raw digest would fail every clean checkout for a difference no edit caused
why_only_these_four: these are exactly the declared inputs that carry no published pin; the five pinned inputs already have an authority (the artefact's sources[]) and re-pinning them here would create a second, weaker one

excluded.scripts/cost_barrier_gate.py: the checker cannot pin itself: a digest the checker verifies against itself is vacuous, and presenting it as assurance would be worse than the gap it names
excluded.data/recovery/wp7/evidence/**: the evidence bundle pins the producers, so it cannot be pinned by them without a cycle; its own integrity is checked against the artefact's published pins

producers.role: producer of the WP-3 audit (the 24 cells)
producer of the market-horizon report (gitignored output)
independent verifier of the explorer artefact
